items.title: は (wa) - topic marker
items.explanation: Marks the topic of the sentence - what we are talking about. Written は, pronounced わ.

items.title: です - is / am / are
items.explanation: The polite ending that links a noun to a statement.

items.title: A は B です
items.explanation: Identifies or classifies the topic: A is B. For geographic location, use A は B にあります。

items.title: を (o) - object marker
items.explanation: Marks the direct object of a verb. Written を, pronounced お.

items.title: に - destination / place
items.explanation: Marks a destination (go to X) or the place where something exists.

items.title: で - place of action
items.explanation: Marks the place where an action happens.

items.title: の - connecting nouns
items.explanation: Connects two nouns: A's B (B of A).

items.title: あります - there is (things)
items.explanation: Used for things that are not alive, and for places.

items.title: います - there is (people, animals)
items.explanation: Used for people and animals.

items.title: ました - polite past
items.pattern: 行きます → 行きました
items.explanation: The polite past tense: 行きます (go) becomes 行きました (went).

items.title: ませんでした - polite past negative
items.pattern: 行きます → 行きませんでした
items.explanation: The polite past negative: 行きませんでした means did not go.

items.title: い-adjectives
items.explanation: Adjectives ending in い (小さい, 美しい) can end a sentence with です.

items.title: か — question
items.pattern: A は B ですか。
items.explanation: Add か to a polite statement to make a question.

items.title: が — subject
items.pattern: N が あります / います。
items.explanation: Marks the subject, including what exists. は sets the topic; が identifies the subject. This is a first distinction, not a complete rule for every context.

items.title: も — also / too
items.explanation: Replaces は when adding another topic with the same property: 富良野も美しいです。

items.title: な-adjectives
items.pattern: きれいな町 / きれいです
items.explanation: Use な before a noun; at the end of a polite sentence use です. きれい ends in い but is a な-adjective. 有名 is also a な-adjective.

items.title: Negative い-adjectives
items.pattern: 美しい → 美しくない
items.explanation: Replace final い with くない. Add です for polite speech. いい is irregular: よくない.

items.title: Polite verbs
items.explanation: Learn the polite form with each verb: 行きます, 見ます, 飲みます, 登ります. ます expresses present habits or future actions, depending on context.

items.title: ません — polite negative
items.pattern: 行きます → 行きません
items.explanation: Replace ます with ません: do not go / will not go.

items.title: Location of a place or thing
items.pattern: A は B にあります。
items.explanation: Use にあります to say where a place or non-living thing is located. A は B です identifies A as B; it does not generally mean A is in B.

items.title: 別の — another / different
items.explanation: 別の場所 means another/different place.

items.title: Reading preview expressions
items.pattern: から / へ / と / て
items.explanation: Reading-only preview: から means from, へ (pronounced え) means toward/to, and 行くと means if/when you go. 入って joins enter to the following action. These are assisted encounters, not required mastery in this package.
